<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Papua protests]]
**Violent protests in [[Papua (province)|Papua]], [[Indonesia]], kill at least 30 people. Most casualties are in [[Wamena]], with deaths also reported in [[Jayapura]]. Victims reportedly receive stab and arrow wounds, and others die in fires as protestors torch government buildings. [http://telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/09/24/fresh-wave-west-papua-violence-leaves-27-dead/ (''The Telegraph'')]

;Business and economy
*[[WeWork]] co-founder [[Adam Neumann]] agrees to resign  as chief executive officer of the office rental firm amid investors increasing concern about the firm's  true  market value which has led to the company postponing its [[initial public offering]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-49803064 (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/24/business/dealbook/wework-ceo-adam-neumann.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A fire in the maternity ward of a hospital in [[El Oued]], [[Algeria]], kills eight newborn babies. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/algeria-hospital-fire-newborn-baby-death-toll-latest-algiers-el-oued-a9117756.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2019 Kashmir earthquake]]
**An earthquake in [[Azad Kashmir]] kills at least 37 people and wounds more than 300 others in [[Pakistan]]. The tremor hits cities including [[Mirpur, Pakistan|Mirpur]] and [[Islamabad]]. The [[Pakistan Armed Forces|military]] commences [[search and rescue]] operations. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-quake-pakistan/death-toll-mounts-in-pakikashmirstan-earthquake-but-panic-subsides-idUSKBN1WA0BZ (Reuters)]
*[[Merrimack Valley gas explosions]]
**The [[National Transportation Safety Board]] of the [[United States]] meets to discuss a final report on the accident, including findings of cause. The explosions killed one, injured dozens, and destroyed or damaged around 100 structures. [https://boston.cbslocal.com/2019/09/24/ntsb-merrimack-valley-gas-explosions-report-columbia-gas/ (CBS Boston)]
*[[Effects of global warming]]
**[[Italy|Italian]] authorities close roads in the [[Val Ferret]] valleys on  [[Mont Blanc de Courmayeur]] and order evacuation of the population in the risk area beneath the [[Planpincieux Glacier]]  following warnings by experts that the glacier, whose movement has accelerated to 50-60cm (16-23in) a day, could collapse. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49820542 (BBC News)] [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/world/2019/09/24/mont-blanc-glacier-risks-collapsing_2141b1f7-5742-4282-b8ce-e442d6744f08.html (Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata)]
*A tanker truck carrying fuel overturns after swerving to avoid a motorcycle in [[Bamako]], [[Mali]]. A subsequent explosion kills six and seriously injures 46 more. Dozens of vehicles burn. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-blast/tanker-truck-explosion-in-mali-capital-kills-six-wounds-46-idUSKBN1W92NX (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Sudan]]ese Finance Minister Ibrahim el-Badawi says [[Prime Minister of Sudan|Prime Minister]] [[Abdalla Hamdok]] is to ask the [[World Bank]] for [[US$]]2 billion. Sudan has been unable to do business with either the World Bank or the [[International Monetary Fund]] because it is featured on the [[United States]]' [[State Sponsors of Terrorism (U.S. list)|State Sponsors of Terrorism list]]. The [[United States Congress|US Congress]] is unlikely to remove Sudan before next year, el-Badawi further announces, saying he has been told the process is complicated. [https://aawsat.com/english/home/article/1916641/us-says-removing-sudan-terror-list-could-take-year (Asharq al-Awsat)]

;Law and crime
*Luxury automaker [[Daimler AG|Daimler]], owner of the [[Mercedes-Benz]] brand, is fined [[euro|€]]870 million by prosecutors in [[Stuttgart]], [[Germany]] for its role in the [[diesel emissions scandal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-daimler-emissions-fine/daimler-to-pay-870-million-euros-fine-in-relation-to-diesel-investigation-idUSKBN1W91KW (Reuters)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Spain]] rules that the body of former ''[[Caudillo]]'' [[Francisco Franco]] can be exhumed from the country's [[Valle de los Caídos]] tomb, where his body has been kept since his death in 1975. The [[Spanish Socialist Workers' Party]]-led [[Sánchez government]] says it will go ahead with the exhumation following the court ruling. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/24/franco-body-moved-burial-site-spain-court (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit]], [[2019 British prorogation controversy]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the United Kingdom|UK Supreme Court]] rules that [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]]'s [[Prorogation in the United Kingdom#Boris Johnson (2019)|prorogation]] of [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]] was an unlawful [[void (law)|nullity]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-49810261 (BBC Newsq)]
*[[Seventy-fourth session of the United Nations General Assembly|U.N. General Assembly 74th session]]
**[[General Debate of the seventy-fourth session of the United Nations General Assembly|General Debate]] opens at the [[Headquarters of the United Nations|UN Headquarters]] in [[New York City]], with [[US President]] [[Donald Trump]] denouncing [[globalism]] and calling [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] "a [[Cuba]]n puppet". [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-un-speech-09-24-2019/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2019/sep/24/trump-bolsonaro-and-johnson-to-open-un-general-assembly-live-news (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Efforts to impeach Donald Trump]], [[2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal]]
**[[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|Speaker of the House]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] announces that [[Efforts to impeach Donald Trump#Start of formal impeachment proceedings|a formal impeachment inquiry]] has been launched into US President Donald Trump. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/24/us/politics/democrats-impeachment-trump.html?smid=fb-nytimes&smtyp=cur (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/powerpost/pelosi-top-democrats-privately-discuss-creation-of-select-committee-for-impeachment/2019/09/24/af6f735a-dedf-11e9-b199-f638bf2c340f_story.html?wpisrc=al_news__alert-politics--alert-national&wpmk=1 (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[September 2019 Indonesian protests and riots]]
**Tens of thousands of students rally against graft laws and new criminal codes across [[Indonesia]]. Some of the protesters violently clash with the riot police, leading to the injury of more than 300 people. [https://www.dw.com/en/indonesia-police-tear-gas-students-protesting-sex-graft-laws/a-50565478 (Deutsche Welle)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/indonesia-protests-80-students-hurt-police-clashes-190925044211780.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Science and technology
*[[Microsoft]] issues an emergency patch for its [[Internet Explorer]] browser to close a vulnerability that allowed cybercriminals to install [[malware]] via boobytrapped websites. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-49809453 (BBC News)]
*The [[European Court of Justice]] rules in favour of United States [[search engine]] [[Google]] in a landmark [[right to be forgotten]] case, rejecting  a [[France|French]] privacy regulator's argument that Google should apply the rules to its results and [[top-level domains|domains]] globally and not only within the [[European Union]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-49808208 (BBC News)]
